segments.he: רַב חִסְדָּא חֲזָא תָּאלֵי בֵּי גוּפְנֵי. אֲמַר לֵיהּ לַאֲרִיסֵיהּ: עַקְרִינְהוּ; גּוּפְנֵי קָנֵי דִּקְלֵי, דִּקְלֵי לָא קָנֵי גּוּפְנֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara relates a similar incident: «Rav Ḥisda saw date palms» growing «among grapevines» on his estate. «He said to his sharecropper: Uproot the» date palms, since one can «purchase date palms» with «grapevines,» as grapevines are more valuable, while one «cannot purchase grapevines» with «date palms.»
